reddit.title: Significant Performance Improvements in Flowing Water Handling
reddit.body: We've made some important optimizations to how flowing lakes are processed in Provincia. Previously, drying a single cell would trigger a full map rescan, which was costly in terms of performance. Now, when a wet cell is cleared, only that specific chunk and its immediate neighbors are updated. This change has reduced the script time for a 64×64 lake from about 20 ms to just 12 ms. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost

steam.title: Flowing Water Performance Update
steam.body: We've implemented a series of optimizations for flowing lakes in Provincia. By limiting the area that needs to be rescanned when a cell dries, we've significantly reduced script processing times. This means smoother gameplay and a better overall experience. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
